messages:
emma (Finance): Heads-up: Partner CloudSpan reported duplicate marketplace charges after their migration. AWS invoice AWS-INV-66122 shows two seat lines for the same customer cs-42 between 2026-04-03 and 2026-04-09. Looks like both old SKU and new SKU billed. Est. overcharge USD 9,750. Need credit memo before month close. @vijay @natalie
vijay (Sales): Partner claims they triggered the migration on 2026-04-03; expected immediate deprovision of old SKU. cc @oliver who coordinated.
natalie (Partner Ops): I see two mapping entries in reseller_mappings for cs-42 with overlapping active_from dates. @billing-bot can you pull raw usage lines for cs-42 Apr 1-10?
billing-bot: Ran query. Overlap days = 7. Duplicate token count = 975,000. Amount = USD 9,750. Created ticket FIN-3612. Related invoice lines: ML-2201, ML-2202.
emma (Finance): Thanks. We need a settlement adjustment to CloudSpan. Dylan, can you prepare the credit memo draft and GL mapping? Attach partner comms.
dylan (RevOps): On it. Need the partner's billing email and the migration confirmation. Natalie, can you attach the partner's migration request?
natalie (Partner Ops): Uploaded migration request to drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/cs-42-migration. Partner note says decommission old SKU on 2026-04-03 at 16:00 UTC.
oliver (AE): Partner requested expedited handling and asked if Redwood can issue credits to their end customers directly. They prefer a single settlement adjustment to their account.
vijay (Sales): We usually issue settlement adjustments to partner; partner handles pass-through. Direct end-customer credits via AWS is possible but slow. Recommend settlement adjustment + credit memo to partner.
emma (Finance): Agreed. Draft details: reason = "Marketplace SKU overlap during offer migration", amount = "USD 9,750", invoice ref = "AWS-INV-66122", GL = "4210". Dylan please include FIN-3612 and invoice line refs. Approval required from finance lead.
dylan (RevOps): Draft:

``
Credit memo to CloudSpan (partner id CS-42)
Amount: USD 9,750
Reason: Duplicate charge due to overlapping SKU billing during AWS Marketplace migration (2026-04-03 to 2026-04-09)
Related invoice: AWS-INV-66122
GL code: 4210
``

Approvers: @emma, @sara (Finance Lead).
sara (Finance Lead): Approved. Please route to AWS settlements and attach FIN-3612 and migration evidence. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Submitted credit memo request to AWS Marketplace team: AWS-SETTLE-9148. ETA 6-8 business days. Ticket FIN-3612 linked.
emma (Finance): I'll record the provisional contra entry in month close and mark as pending settlement. Thanks everyone.
natalie (Partner Ops): :thumbsup: Notifying partner about expected timeline.
